github.description: GitHub repository browsing, issue and pull-request inspection. Read-only by default; PR creation scoped to this repository only.
github.trustBoundary: Authenticated via gh CLI login (GITHUB_TOKEN env var or gh auth). Scoped to the scholarchain repository. No cross-repo write authority.

aws-inspect.description: AWS API read-only inspection for S3, Neptune, DynamoDB, EMR, ECS, ECR, KMS, CloudWatch. No write, delete, or mutating operations.
aws-inspect.trustBoundary: Read-only AWS API access. Credentials from environment or AWS CLI profile. No create, update, or delete permissions. Mutating commands are blocked by hooks and permission rules.

terraform-docs.description: Terraform provider and resource documentation lookup. No plan, apply, or state access.
terraform-docs.trustBoundary: Documentation-only access to Terraform provider schemas and resource documentation. No access to state files, plans, or cloud credentials.

aws-docs.description: AWS documentation lookup for service limits, API references, and best practices.
aws-docs.trustBoundary: Read-only documentation access. No AWS credentials or API access required.
